```{r}
set.seed(1) #added 9/14
library(dreamlet)
library(tidyverse)
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(BiocParallel)

# Set up parallel processing with 8 cores
bpparam <- MulticoreParam(workers = 8)
mm_formula = "~ age_genotype + age_genotype:sex + 0 + (1|strain)" %>% as.formula()

#list of model contrasts
#prolonged exposure to amyloid contrast
prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m = "age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeold_Ntg"
early_amyloid_contrast_m = "age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg"
aging_contrast_m = "age_genotypeold_Ntg - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg"

prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeold_Ntg + `age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)"
early_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)"
aging_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_Ntg +`age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)  - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)"


late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD)"
late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`)"


effect_of_sex_young_ntg = "`age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`"
effect_of_sex_young_5x = "`age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`"
effect_of_sex_old_ntg = "`age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`"
effect_of_sex_old_5x = "`age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`"





#contrasts in dreamlet style 
custom_contrasts = c(prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m = "age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeold_Ntg", early_amyloid_contrast_m = "age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg", aging_contrast_m = "age_genotypeold_Ntg - age_genotypeyoung_Ntg", prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeold_Ntg + `age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)", early_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)", aging_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_Ntg +`age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale`)  - (age_genotypeyoung_Ntg + `age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale`)",late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD - age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD)",
late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f = "(age_genotypeold_5XFAD + `age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale`) - (age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD + `age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale`)"
)
```

Male analysis
```{r}
h5ad_file = "./dreamlet-anndata.h5ad"
# Create SingleCellExperiment object that points to on-disk H5AD file
sce <- readH5AD(h5ad_file, use_hdf5 = TRUE)

pb <- aggregateToPseudoBulk(sce,
  assay = "X",
  cluster_id = "cluster",
  sample_id = "animal_id",
  BPPARAM = bpparam
)
 

#keep default params
processed_assay = processAssays(pb,
                                     mm_formula, 
                                     BPPARAM = bpparam)

qs2::qs_save(processed_assay, "../intermediate_dreamlet_obj.qs2")
saveRDS(processed_assay, "../intermediate_dreamlet_obj.rds")

# Differential expression analysis within each assay

processed_de_results <- dreamlet(processed_assay, mm_formula, BPPARAM = bpparam, contrasts = custom_contrasts)
qs2::qs_save(processed_de_results, "../processed_dreamlet.qs2")
```


extract and process the data (extract contrasts and perform BH correction)
```{r}
processed_de_results = qs2::qs_read("../processed_dreamlet.qs2")
#multi term coefficients + single terms
coef_names_to_extract = names(custom_contrasts) %>% c("age_genotypeyoung_Ntg:sexFemale", "age_genotypeyoung_5XFAD:sexFemale","age_genotypeold_Ntg:sexFemale","age_genotypeold_5XFAD:sexFemale")
names(coef_names_to_extract) = c(names(custom_contrasts),"effect_of_sex_young_ntg","effect_of_sex_young_5x","effect_of_sex_old_ntg","effect_of_sex_old_5x")

results_list = list()
for(i in seq_along(coef_names_to_extract)){
  coef_name = coef_names_to_extract[i]
  de_results_contrast = topTable(processed_de_results, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "none") %>% as.data.frame()
  de_results_contrast$comparison = names(coef_names_to_extract)[i]
  results_list[[i]] = de_results_contrast
}
de_results = bind_rows(results_list)
de_results = de_results %>% rename("cluster" = "assay")
de_results = de_results %>% rename("gene" = "ID")

#BH correction within each cluster/contrast
de_results = de_results %>% ungroup %>% 
  group_by(cluster, comparison) %>%
  mutate(adj.P.Val = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "BH"))

qs2::qs_save(de_results, "../dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")

```
